description: How a provision changed between two dates: a word-level diff of its text on date_a and its text on date_b, and the laws that took effect after date_a, up to and including date_b.

max_chars.description: Longest part of the text in one answer (default 40000, at least 1000, at most 100000). A longer text comes in parts.

offset.description: Where the part starts, in characters: the offset the previous part gave for the next one (default 0).

path.description: A provision file, for example united-states/federal/usc/title-11/1182.md, from find_provision.

name: compare_dates
title: Compare dates
